suggestion.expand_description: Describe the work in a few more lines. Clear posts get replies from people who actually fit.
suggestion.add_skills: Add the skills this needs, so it reaches people who have them.
suggestion.fewer_skills: Ask for the 3 to 5 skills that matter most. Long lists put good people off.
suggestion.add_location: Add the area where the work happens, so nearby people see it.
suggestion.consider_remote: If some of the work can be done from home, allow remote. You will likely get more responses.
suggestion.add_salary: Add a monthly salary range. Jobs that show pay get many more applications.
suggestion.lower_qualification: Lower the minimum qualification to 12th if the work allows it. You will likely get more responses.
suggestion.relax_english: Ask for basic English if the job doesn't need more. Many good candidates will then apply.
suggestion.lower_experience: Asking for over 2 years' experience cuts the list a lot. Consider accepting less.
suggestion.add_job_timings: Add the job timings (for example 9 am to 6 pm), so people know if it suits them.
suggestion.add_interview_details: Say how and where the interview happens. It builds trust.
suggestion.add_openings: Say how many people you are hiring.
suggestion.add_shift: Say whether it is a day, night or rotational shift.
suggestion.add_budget: Add a budget or an hourly rate. Projects that show one get better proposals.
suggestion.add_duration: Say how long the project will run.
suggestion.add_screening_question: Add a screening question to see quickly who has done this before.
suggestion.relax_experience_level: Asking only for experts narrows the field. Allow intermediate if you can.
suggestion.add_deadline: Add a deadline for proposals, so people apply sooner.
suggestion.add_preferred_date: Add the date you need this done.
suggestion.add_local_budget: Add a rough budget, so professionals can quote quickly.
suggestion.add_urgency: Say how soon you need it: today, this week or flexible.

disclosure.whatsapp_only: Anyone who messages you on WhatsApp from this post will see your phone number. They can't ring you from Vyapar.
disclosure.call_and_whatsapp: Anyone who calls or messages you from this post will see your phone number, and can reach you on it later.
